previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 6.0 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination was normal. Discussed risk of prostate cancer and decided to proceed with transrectal ultrasound-guided systematic biopsy. Biopsy performed on 15 Aug 2023, results returned as negative for malignancy. Advised repeat PSA in 6 months.
